items.title: Stalks of flat modules are flat: \mathcal{F} flat \Rightarrow \mathcal{F}_p flat over \mathcal{O}_p
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proof is a reduction: it views the point p as the morphism of ringed topoi (p, id_{\mathcal{O}_p}) : (\Sh(pt), \mathcal{O}_p) \to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) whose pullback functor equals the stalk functor (the identification established in the section on skyscraper sheaves), so that the stalk \mathcal{F}_p is literally the pullback p^*\mathcal{F}; flatness then follows from the same-chapter lemma that pullback preserves flatness. The identification of stalks as pullback along the point is the substance.
